title: Operations Action Queue + SLA Escalation
businessRequirement: Extend the staging-accepted Operations Control + Exception Dashboard into a governed internal action queue that lets authorized operations users take ownership of existing exceptions, acknowledge work, assign or reassign an owner, set/adjust due dates, complete linked operational tasks, and surface SLA/escalation state using existing approved Task, Approval, Booking, AuditEvent and exception data. Preserve all existing booking, document, finance, payment, release, NVOCC and Forwarding workflow rules.
objective: Move from exception visibility to controlled operational follow-through without creating a second workflow engine or changing the frozen transactional baseline.
preservedChangeRequests: CR-20260923-001 — Operations Control + Exception Dashboard — staging acceptance PASS
CR-20260923-002 — ECOM final resilience hardening — preserve approved API hardening behavior
impactedModules: existing Task, Approval, Booking and AuditEvent data

impactAssessment.web: REQUIRED — add an Action Queue view/controls inside the accepted Operations Control surface and keep the frozen WorkspaceShell/navigation conventions.
impactAssessment.api: REQUIRED — add narrowly scoped internal mutations for task ownership/acknowledgement/due-date/completion where existing APIs are insufficient; retain bookingScope and internal-role enforcement.
impactAssessment.shared: REQUIRED — UI controls and API authorization/audit behavior must evolve together.
impactAssessment.dataMigration: NOT_REQUIRED — reuse existing Task fields (ownerId, dueAt, status, slaState) and existing AuditEvent/booking relations; no new schema planned.
impactAssessment.securityPrivacy: REQUIRED — mutations remain internal-only, branch scoped, fail closed, and must never expose customer/shipper/agent private data beyond existing permissions.
impactAssessment.financeReleaseControls: NO_RULE_CHANGE — queue may link to payment/release blockers but must not override or mutate finance/release-security decisions.
impactAssessment.workflowCompatibility: REQUIRED — task actions are additive operational coordination only; they must not introduce or change booking lifecycle states.

queueFunctions: Claim/assign an exception-backed task to an authorized internal owner
Reassign task owner within permitted scope
Acknowledge work using approved Task.status values
Set or adjust operational due date
Derive ON_TRACK / AT_RISK / OVERDUE escalation presentation from dueAt and slaState
Open the existing job/document/payment/tracking/integration remediation surface
escalation: Highlight overdue or critical items in the Operations Control queue
Expose CONTROL_TOWER visibility for unresolved cross-branch critical items without broadening mutation rights
Do not auto-change booking, payment, document or release state
audit: Record actor, action, linked booking/task, previous value and new value using existing audit facilities where available
Keep action history visible from the job/control context

regressionPlan.rule: Planning only. If later BUILD_APPROVED, classify as SHARED and require all Web/API build gates plus role/privacy browser UAT, responsive/failure/accessibility, full transaction lifecycle, resilience/security regression, and targeted action-queue E2E before any staging deployment approval.

acceptanceCriteria: Accepted CR-001 dashboard categories, counts, filters and direct links remain intact.
Authorized internal users can claim/assign, acknowledge, reassign, adjust due date and complete an existing linked task from the control workflow.
Task action changes are reflected consistently on the job Task surface and Operations Control queue.
External CUSTOMER, SHIPPER and AGENT roles cannot read or mutate internal action-queue controls.
BRANCH_OPS mutations remain limited to bookings in the permitted branch; global visibility does not imply global mutation permission.
SLA/escalation status is deterministic from approved task/due-date data and does not create duplicate tasks or exception rows.
Every mutation is auditable with actor and before/after context using existing audit facilities.
No booking lifecycle, finance, payment, document release, NVOCC/Forwarding or carrier privacy rule changes.
Full SHARED regression and targeted action-queue E2E must pass before any staging deployment can be approved.
approvalRequired: Further deployment or any production promotion requires a new explicit user approval.
